source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In a survey of 59 women with NF1, 53 (89%) who received oral estrogen-progestogen or pure progestogen preparations reported no associated neurofibroma growth, while 2 women (3%) who received depot contraceptives containing a high dose of synthetic progesterone reported significant tumor growth.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 115 Lammert 2005 PMID 15703081.
